chapter.verse: Mi liante tawh an nekhawm dingin na tut ciangin, na tutpihpa lim takin en in.
An ngaklah thei mi na hih leh zong lim takin kidawm in.
Hong thangsiahna hikha thei ding ahih manin, tua an limte lunggulh lua pah kei in.
Hauh nop man bekin sum’ sila suak kei in la, a man loin gamta kha kei in.
Na ngahsa, sumte, mitphiat kalin bei mang thei a, muvanlai bangin thakhatin lengmang thei hi.
A cil tentan mite’ an neksak kei in la, a an limte uh duhgawh kha kei in.
“Ne ne in hong cih hangin,” a cih takpi hi lo hi. Na dangtawng hong sun samzang nek khak tawh kibang ding hi.
Na neksa teng na luakhia kik ding a, na kamsiam ngah teng maimang ta ding hi.
Mihaite, pil hopih kei in, a manphatna phawk thei lo uh hi.
Taanglai gi-suang khin kei in la, tagahte’ leitang va keek kei in.
Amaute a Hupa in a tha hat a, nang’ lang khatah amaute pan’pih ding hi.
Hong kihilhnate zui-in la, pilna thu hong kigente ngai in.
Naupangte sat ding lunghiang kei in; satna hangin si lo ding hi.
Ciangduai tawh sat lecin, nuntak lawhzaw ding hi.
Ka ta aw, mipil suak lecin, ka lungdam mahmah ding hi.
Thuman na gen ciangin, ka nuam mahmah ding hi.
Mawhnei mite eng kha kei in la, Topa na zahtakna zom paisuak in.
Tua bang hi lecin lametna om a, ci-thei-in na khan’ a sau ding hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thu ngai in la mipil suak in; lampi man zuih ding ngaihsutpi-in nei in.
Zu ne nete tawh kikhawl kei in la, a uisante tawh kithuah kha kei in.
Zu nete leh a uisante zawng ding uh a, a ne bek-a nitumte in puansia bek silh zo ding uh hi.
Na pian’na na pa’ thu ngai in la, na nu a teek ciangin simmawh bawl kei in.
Thuman, pilna, siamna, thu ngaihsut theihna lei in; tuate zuakkhiat dingin pammaih lua hi.
Ta hoih a neipa in a lungdam ding a, ta pil a neipa in a ta tungah lungkim ding hi.
Na nu leh na pa a kipah nadingin gamta in la, na pian’na na nu lungdamsak in.
Ka ta aw, na lungtang kei hong pia in la, ka gamtatnate na mit-in en gige in.
Numei paktatte in kiat theihna gum tawh kibang a, numei ginalote in tangciak theihna hawkguam tawh kibang hi.
Gutate bangin nang hong buksim a, mi tampi tak siasak uh hi.
Kuate in gal nei a, kuate in dahna thuak hiam? Thu om lopi-in kuate liam a, thu om lopi-in kuate a mit san gega hiam?
Zu ne-a a tut khote, zu a ne nete ahi hi.
Hai sungah a phuan seuhseuh, gawl sungah a tum suk hit-hit thei, leenggahzu san etin nei kei in.
A tawpna-ah gulpi bangin hong tu ding a, gul gu nei bangin hong tu ding hi.
Na mit-ah na lamdang dang hong suak ding a, hoih takin na pau thei nawn kei ding hi.
Tuipi tunga lum tawh na kibang ding a, a suk-awn a to-awn teembaw dawn-a tuang tawh na kibang ding hi.
“Hong vuak hangun ka liam kei a, hong sat hangun ka phawk kei hi. Ka pilvan' ciangin zu ka ne kik ding hi,” na ci ding hi.
